hdr_size_varint = bytearray()
while True:
    b = data[pos]
    hdr_size_varint.append(b)
    pos += 1
    if not (b & 0x80):
        break

hdr_size_len = len(hdr_size_varint)
raw_hdr_size = 0
for i, b in enumerate(hdr_size_varint):
    raw_hdr_size |= (b & 0x7F) << (7 * i)

hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + hdr_size_len
print(f"MAIN header_size varint: {bytes(hdr_size_varint).hex()}, raw_hdr_size={raw_hdr_size}, hdr_size_len={hdr_size_len}, hdr_size={hdr_size}")

# CRC data
crc_data = data[12:12+hdr_size]
computed_crc = zlib.crc32(crc_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
print(f"MAIN CRC data ({len(crc_data)} bytes): {crc_data.hex()}")
print(f"MAIN CRC stored: {main_crc:08x}, computed: {computed_crc:08x}, match: {main_crc == computed_crc}")
